items.title: Electric Fans and Electric Motors (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Electric Fans and Electric Motors: a main subheading of 16.10 Use of Capacitors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 80-81.

blocks.text: Pankhe ki motor ke starting hisse (starting coil) ke saath capacitor jora jata hai. Bijli ON karte hi capacitor charge hona shuru hota hai. Is ki madad se motor static friction (ruki cheez ki ragar) aur inertia (apni halat na badalne ki aadat) ki shuru wali rukawat ko overcome kar ke (par qaboo pa kar) jaldi ghoomna shuru kar deti hai. Washing machines, blenders, choppers, grinders aur pani ki motors mein bhi capacitor yahi kaam karta hai.
